evidence.text: Our operations are organized along our distribution channels, and we have the following three reportable sales segments: domestic wholesale sales, international wholesale sales, which include international direct subsidiary sales and international distributor sales, and direct-to-consumer sales, which includes our company-owned retail stores and direct-to-consumer websites. We evaluate segment performance based primarily on sales and gross margins. See detailed segment information in Note 20 – Segment and Geographic Reporting in our Consolidated Financial Statements included under Part II, Item 8 of this annual report.
